title: Space Bash — Orbital Breakfloor
description: A 2–10 contestant physics survival arena with throwable crates, TNT/Nitro, destructible floor tiles, multi-touch controls and bot-filled solo play.

source.provenance: User-directed original standalone HTML implementation developed in this ChatGPT project. The imported v1.13.1 build is self-contained Canvas 2D/JavaScript with procedural visuals and audio; no third-party game code, artwork, music, or binary assets are included. Vault v2 room adapters add bounded remote input and pause/safe-cancel seams; the pre-room packaged page is preserved in source/original/standalone-before-room.html. No physics or camera retuning.
